title: Native Data Types for Grasshopper Params
description: Refactor all Grasshopper component params to use native GH data types: DateTime params for CreatedAt/UpdatedAt timestamps instead of text, Colour params for hex color strings, ensuring all params have native equivalence
summary: Refactored all GH component params to use native Grasshopper data types: timestamps (File, Folder, Type, Design, Kit) changed from AddTextParameter to AddTimeParameter with proper DateTime handling; colors (Layer, Group, Piece) changed from AddTextParameter to AddColourParameter with hex↔Color conversion via HexToColor/ColorToHex helpers in RhinoConverter. Zero compilation errors confirmed.
